title: TransferOwnershipFlow
wrapsNative: MonarchBottomSheet holding MonarchStepper, MonarchEntityPicker, MonarchConsequenceList and MonarchButton, opened from a danger MonarchButton
summary: Hands a workspace to another member in three steps inside a bottom sheet: choose the new owner, review what changes for both sides, then confirm.
whenToUse: In workspace or organization settings, for the owner to transfer ownership to another eligible member.
whenNotToUse: For changing an ordinary member's role use a role picker on the member row; for deleting the workspace use a danger-zone confirmation.
api: MonarchBottomSheet(onDismissRequest = …, title = "Transfer ownership") { Column(Modifier.verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) { MonarchStepper(steps = steps, current = step); when (step) { 0 -> MonarchEntityPicker(label = "New owner", entities = members, selected = newOwner, onSelectedChange = …); 1 -> MonarchConsequenceList(items = …, heading = "What changes"); else -> MonarchText(…) }; Row { MonarchButton(text = "Back", variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Ghost, …); MonarchButton(text = "Continue" or "Transfer ownership", variant = Primary or Danger, enabled = newOwner != null, …) } } }

options.name: members
options.description: Members who could become the owner, without the current owner; members who cannot (not an admin) are listed with enabled = false and a hint saying why.

options.name: steps
options.description: Choose the new owner, What changes, Confirm.

options.name: consequences
options.description: What changes for you (your new role, what you can no longer do) and for the new owner, with Changed, Removed and Warning kinds.

options.name: your role
options.description: Add on the review step when the owner can choose their role after the transfer.

options.name: re-authentication
options.description: Ask before running the transfer when the product requires it.

options.name: result
options.description: "<name> is now the owner.", or "Waiting for <name> to accept" when the new owner must accept.

states.name: choose
states.description: The entity picker; Continue is disabled until a member is chosen.

states.name: review
states.description: The consequence list for both sides.

states.name: confirm
states.description: A sentence naming the new owner and a danger Transfer ownership button.

states.name: done
states.description: The sheet closes and a success banner names the new owner.

appearance: The Material 3 bottom sheet on the raised surface with its drag handle; inside, MonarchStepper, the entity picker field, the consequence list with its kind marks and the danger button keep their own appearance in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web TransferOwnershipFlow is one component built on WizardDialog, AssigneePicker and ConsequenceList with built-in strings, eligibility by role, a role select, step-up authentication and a pending-acceptance screen. On a phone a multi-step dialog is a bottom sheet, so Android composes a MonarchBottomSheet with MonarchStepper and the same parts; eligibility, the role choice, step-up and acceptance are the app's additions to the recipe (see options). The system back gesture closes the sheet. iOS has no entry yet.
accessibility: The sheet title is a heading and MonarchStepper says which step of three is current.
Members who cannot become the owner are read as disabled, with the reason in their hint.
Each consequence is read with its kind in words.
The final button names the action ("Transfer ownership") and uses the danger variant, not color alone.
Continue is disabled, and read as disabled, until a member is chosen.
edgeCases: Opening the sheet again starts at the first step with nobody chosen.
Dismissing the sheet by dragging or Back cancels without transferring.
With nobody eligible, show a message instead of the picker and keep Continue disabled.
